info.description: Fugu Ultra coordinates a deeper pool of expert agents to maximize answer quality on hard, high-stakes problems. v2.0 accepts reasoning efforts high and xhigh; max is accepted as an alias of xhigh. The Responses API defaults to xhigh for fugu-ultra.

zh.description: Fugu Ultra 协调更深的专家模型池，在高风险难题上尽量提高回答质量。v2.0 的思考档位是 high 与 xhigh；max 作为 xhigh 的别名被接受。Responses API 对 fugu-ultra 的默认档位是 xhigh。
